title: Southwest Research analysis of the implant sliver
place_text: Southwest Research Institute, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: Bill says, "I've got your piece of your sliver of the implant." And he [clears throat] says it is um a metal metallic base with febrow motion moving uh uh celia coming off of it.

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber, who says he has been in contact with non-human beings, tells of a small sliver he believed was an implant placed in his body. Strieber says that in the mid-1990s a man named Bill, William Malow, studied a piece of it at the Southwest Research Institute, a research lab in San Antonio, Texas, and told him it had a metal base with tiny moving hair-like strands coming off it. If true, it would suggest the object was something no ordinary source would produce.
